question.prompt:
Three vertices of rectangle \(ABCD\) are \(A(-1,-1)\), \(B(3,-1)\), and \(C(3,2)\). Let the coordinates of the fourth vertex D be \((a,b)\) and the area of the rectangle be \(S\). Find \(a\), \(b\), and \(S\), in that order (separate your answers with commas).

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_084_q4_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: The sides of the rectangle are parallel to the coordinate axes. D has the same x-coordinate as A and the same y-coordinate as C, so \(D(-1,2)\). Since \(AB=4\) and \(BC=3\), the area is \(S=4\times3=12\).
solutions.title: Use shared coordinates and side lengths
